ctx.x: Did you have somebody's phone number? Were you gonna check up with somebody?

I had a couple of phone numbers and uh, Ed Thigpen, uh, comes to mind who had encour… anybody who had come to this club, I tried to get their number. But uh, you could find a lot of 'em who I had met there uh, playing at different places, jam sessions and things, so I had uh, uh, a plan in mind to uh, start, uh, to enroll in Manhattan School of Music. But realistically, I wasn't quite ready because I hadn't worked uh, diligently enough on certain pieces, you know, that were required. Not that there was a list of…
